- Job title: Applied Scientist II / Senior Applied Scientist - Responsible AI (CoreAI)
- Location: Redmond, Washington
- Job number: 200017828
- Work-site arrangement: 3 days / week in-office

2) Work with the tech lead on the design and implementation of Agent adversarial evaluations and safety mitigations, enabling agent creators to identify potential risks and apply appropriate safeguards to ensure the safety and security of Agents.

Two preferred qualifications (from the Preferred Qualifications section for this specific listing):
1) Rich experience in machine learning, particularly in NLP and deep learning.
2) Experience with language model training and evaluation is a big plus.

No sign-in, application, or form submission actions were taken, and only this one relevant listing was opened to collect the requested details.
